population: The same 40 SEM-C0 ELIGIBLE queries used by SEM-B1
span_rule: Choose one exact contiguous whitespace-delimited source span with Qwen3-8B tokens <= the paired canonical-fact token count; maximize 2*fact lexical overlap + question lexical overlap, then overlap count, token count, earliest offset
interpretation: If ideal semantic does not beat this control on quality/safety, shortening rather than rewriting is sufficient; all context costs remain separately reported.
